Name: Ephes-dammim
Description: The place where the Philistines gathered between Shochoh and Azekah, and Saul and Israel pitched by the valley of Elah, where David met Goliath; called Pas-dammim in Chronicles, where Eleazar stood against the Philistines.
BiblicalSignificance: Ephes-dammim is the battlefield of David and Goliath: two armies on two hills, and a shepherd boy walking into the valley between them.
